newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Egana names advisers for spinoff of unit.
newsitem.headline: Egana names advisers for spinoff of unit.

text.p: Watch and jewellery products maker and distributor Egana International (Holdings) Ltd said on Tuesday it had appointed financial advisers on the spinning off of its jewellery operation in Hong Kong.

"The company has appointed Somerley Ltd as its financial advisers for the purpose of seeking a separate listing of this (jewellery) business on the Stock Exchnage of Hong Kong Ltd," Egana said in an earnings statement.
"The existing shareholders of the company will be given preferential rights to participate in the new jewellery group upon the new issue of the spun-off vehicle."
It gave no further details or the timing of the spinoff.
Egana said it expected the contribution from its jewellery operations to progressively increase.
In 1996, jewellery sales and licensing income from the use of jewellery brandnames accounted for about 25 percent of the group's turnover.
Egana posted a profit of HK$121.38 million for the year ended in December 1996, up from HK$107.58 million in 1995.
Turnover increased to HK$1.32 billion in 1996 from HK$1.27 billion the year before.
